name: gresca
description: A fan-made freestyle ski and snowboard game for the browser, with tests that run the real game scripts in Node

scripts.test:rotated: GRESCA_MAP_ROTATION_DEG=37 node --test --test-reporter=dot test/*.test.js && GRESCA_MAP_ROTATION_DEG=300 node --test --test-reporter=dot test/*.test.js
